User story: As a user, I want to enter a request through a simple conversation interface so that I do not need to navigate complex menus.
Notes: Typed interaction first; voice adapter TBD

User story: As a user, I want every consequential action read back for confirmation so that the assistant does not act without my approval.
As a user, I want to request a doctor appointment in natural language so that scheduling is easier.
As a user, I want to see or hear my upcoming appointments so that I know what is scheduled.
As a user, I want configurable appointment reminders so that I do not miss appointments.
As a user, I want medication reminders and an acknowledgement option so that I can keep track of doses.
As a user, I want the assistant to support my preferred language so that I can complete important tasks comfortably.
As a user, I want to dictate a message to my care team and confirm it before sending.
Notes: Mock integration before any real provider integration

User story: As a user, I want typed choices or human/caregiver help when the assistant cannot understand me.
As a user, I want to control exactly which task-level information a caregiver can see.
As a user, I want to configure or disable proactive check-ins so that they do not become intrusive.
As a user, I want help arranging a ride to an appointment.
Notes: Weak survey priority and external integration required

User story: As a team, we want automated tests and continuous integration so that changes can be reviewed safely.
As a team, we want a documented voice and AI technology decision so that implementation is not tied to an untested provider.
